'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Thomas Whitley LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Whitley]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Good Times. Transcription note: sheet name "Thomas Whitley"; objective on line 2 (line 1 is Anger, Fear, Aggression); shield 6 struck, only 8 shields listed; some lines have "(V)" written in the margin

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
